column1: # Common corpus of the classification bench. Hand-written: the forms follow the command heads most frequent in real
# agent sessions, rewritten with neutral paths, never copied.
# Format: <expected verdict in ask mode>[/<verdict today>]<TAB><command>. Judged in the fixture project of
# The expected verdict follows the shipped policy: sed and awk scripts that only read are allowed, python and yq ask
# (they can write or run code), rm inside the project asks and danger is kept for what cannot be undone. "/today" marks
# a verdict a later fix is expected to change; the test checks today's verdict until then. A correction that changes any
# other line must say so in its report.

column2: for f in src/*.ts; do wc -l "$f"; done
